title: Geauxn Coastal | Stately WaterColor Home | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Geaux’n Coastal is a WaterColor retreat with bikes, a private courtyard, screened porches, Beach Club access, and a short walk to Western Lake.
description_expanded: $250 Concierge Credit for Summer! Receive a $250 credit to use on concierge services for arrivals May 23, 2026 - August 8, 2026 if you book by August 8, 2026 when you use code GEAUXN250 at check-out* Geaux'n Coastal Features - Enjoy 4 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep them in top shape - 2 Minute bike ride to the WaterColor Beach Club - 1 Minute Walk to Western Lake pier featuring a kayak or YOLO board launch - Buttercup Park is a 30 second walk from the home - perfect for kids to run around - Private courtyard with propane grill and enclosed outdoor shower - Spacious living room with indoor fireplace and Smart TV - Screened-in front porch with outdoor dining, outdoor sofas, and ceiling fans - very relaxing private outdoor space - Screened-in front balcony with cushioned lounge seating and Adirondack chairs - accessed from the two King suites - Dining for 11 - Full Kitchen with high-end stainless-steel appliances from GE, Cuisinart and Keurig, granite countertops, and kitchen island - Driveway parking for 2 SUVs or 3 sedans - Cable and WIFI - 1st Floor Laundry room with washer and dryer plus storage and sink - Access to WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and community pools included in your reservation for 10 guests ages 5 and older - Community pools heated during cooler months (subject to change by the neighborhood) - Concierge services, including baby equipment rentals, beach chair rentals, and grocery delivery available - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee - Low Speed Vehicle rentals available through Electric Cart Company, the exclusive provider for WaterColor. We recommend making a reservation as soon as possible as there is a limited number of carts available. Welcome to Geaux'n Coastal! Thoughtfully planned, this home is a wonderful place to enjoy a WaterColor vacation experience. Only a 2-minute bike ride to the WaterColor Beach Club, you are close to the popular neighborhood amenities while staying on a quiet street to enjoy peaceful moments on the screened-in porch and balcony. There is also a pocket park near the home which is great for the kids to spend some playtime. The 30A area is continually growing and evolving. As a result, nearby construction, renovations, or public works projects may occur during your stay. While we strive to provide an exceptional experience, these activities are beyond our control. Refunds or discounts cannot be offered for construction-related noise, disruptions, or changes in views. * One promotion or discount per reservation. Promotions or discounts cannot be combined
